categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in manufacturing and trading of screws, nuts, washers, bolts, mechanical hardware, hand tools, automotive materials and parts, steel wire rods, and related metal products. It also engages in processing such as spheroidizing heat treatment, casting, and surface treatment. Additionally, the company is involved in industrial machinery manufacturing, real estate development, chemical manufacturing, and general import-export trade.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced manufacturing processes including cold forging, heat treatment (spheroidizing annealing), acid pickling, wire drawing, and surface coating such as phosphating and electroplating. It employs automated production lines and quality management systems certified under ISO 9001 and ISO 14001. The group also integrates upstream steel billet production with downstream wire rod and screw manufacturing, leveraging vertical integration and process automation.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include industrial sectors such as machinery, electronics, electrical appliances, furniture, construction, transportation equipment, and automotive industries. The company serves both domestic and international markets, with significant exports to the United States and Europe. It also targets emerging markets in Southeast Asia, including Myanmar, Laos, and Cambodia, through distributors and trading partners.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates production and sales facilities in Taiwan, Thailand, and China, with overseas subsidiaries and trading companies in Europe (Germany, UK, Spain), Singapore, and China. Its sales network covers domestic Taiwan markets, Southeast Asia, North America, and Europe, leveraging global supply chain and marketing channels.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates across the midstream and downstream segments of the steel supply chain, producing steel billets, wire rods, and finished fasteners such as screws and bolts. It vertically integrates upstream raw material supply (steel billets) through investments in electric arc furnace steelmaking, midstream wire rod and spheroidizing wire production, and downstream screw and bolt manufacturing and processing.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include expanding production capacity for acid pickling and heat treatment lines, enhancing automation and process improvements to increase yield and quality, and developing diversified product lines including specialty screws and automotive fasteners. The company emphasizes vertical integration to control raw material quality and cost, and invests in R&D for advanced heat treatment and surface technologies. It also focuses on sustainability and environmental certifications.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through product sales of steel wire rods, screws, bolts, steel bars, and related processed metal products. The company also earns income from processing services and trading activities. There is no indication of subscription or licensing revenue; sales are largely transactional with both domestic and international customers.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes with major domestic steel producers such as China Steel Corporation and other Taiwanese and Southeast Asian fastener manufacturers. It faces competition from low-cost Chinese imports, especially in Southeast Asia. The company positions itself as a vertically integrated, quality-focused supplier with diversified product offerings and global market reach, aiming to differentiate through product quality and integrated supply chain control.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2022, the company reported consolidated revenues of approximately NT$8 billion, a slight decrease from the previous year, with a net loss attributable to the parent company of NT$165 million. The group employs around 1,000 employees and has experienced challenges due to market volatility and pricing pressures. Despite short-term losses, the company pursues growth through capacity expansion and market diversification, with a focus on improving profitability and operational efficiency.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its vertically integrated production model from steel billets to finished fasteners, ensuring stable material supply and quality control. It offers a diverse product portfolio with advanced manufacturing technologies such as spheroidizing heat treatment to enhance product durability and performance. The company also highlights its certifications, automation, and customer-centric flexible pricing strategies as competitive advantages to meet varied customer needs and maintain market leadership.
